text:
sara_pm: Quick sync — compiling enterprise compliance roadmap (audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2/ISO, data retention). Need prioritization and launch criteria for Dedicated + Private. Can we align on MVP scope and blockers? I'm thinking: 1) Immutable audit logs with export; 2) BYOK via KMS + rotation policy; 3) SOC2 gap analysis + doc package; 4) configurable retention policies per org. Who has hard customer asks we should surface?

devin_security: +1. Customer asks: two large finance customers need BYOK + HSM by Q3. Also audit logs must be queryable for 90 days and exportable to S3. SOC2 is a multi-team long pole (policy + infra + legal).

mike_backend: For BYOK we need KMS integration and a key-rotation workflow. Backend effort estimate: 6 weeks core integration + 2w for rotation UI + 2w for e2e tests. Audit logs: streaming to S3/kinesis is straightforward but immutable retention requires write-once storage or append-only buckets.

jen_legal: SOC2: we should scope controls first. Legal can draft evidence templates but need platform controls implemented before an audit engagement. Also data retention ranges: customers will ask for 30/90/365 day tiers and an "infinite" archival option under contract.

anna_sales: To prioritize: if we commit to BYOK + 90d audit logs by Q3 we can close two deals. Sales needs an exact delivery commitment and clear acceptance criteria (e.g., BYOK KMS integration + ability to upload keys, audit log export to S3 + sample CSV output).

sara_pm: Proposed MVP (scope negotiation):
- BYOK: support AWS KMS + upload/rotate keys; UI to attach org key; SDK header for key id. Acceptance: can encrypt/decrypt model artifacts with customer key in Private.
- Audit logs: append-only event stream with S3 export, searchable metadata (request_id, model, route, user_id) for 90-day retention. Acceptance: export job produces gzipped CSV of events and query returns results under 10s for common filters.
- SOC2: readiness checklist and evidence collection automation (not full audit). Acceptance: checklist + prepackaged evidence folder.
- Data retention: retention policy per org configurable via Console with presets 30/90/365/infinite.

mike_backend: That's reasonable but FYI HSM/BYOK for on-prem differs a lot from hosted. Recommend we split BYOK into: 1) Hosted KMS integration (MVP), 2) Private/HSM path (follow-up).

devin_security: Agree. Also note ops constraints: KMS calls must not add >10ms median to request path; consider envelope encryption and async key ops for tokens.

jen_legal: For SOC2 readiness let's attach a baseline timeline: 4 weeks for controls implementation docs + 6 weeks cross-team to collect evidence before we run an external readiness review.

sara_pm: Ok action items:
- mike to produce a tech spike ticket for Hosted AWS KMS BYOK and audit log S3 export (estimates + blockers) — due EOD Tue
- devin to document performance/security SLOs for KMS (latency, key usage limits) — due Wed
- jen to draft SOC2 evidence templates and desired controls — due Fri
- anna to lock customer expectations and push for a realistic contract clause (no HSM promises in MVP) — ongoing

ops-bot: Reminder: #roadmap-planning sync on Thu 10:00 (calendar invite sent)

sara_pm: Thanks team — will collect tickets and circulate a prioritized plan with proposed Q3 milestones by Friday.
